info.title: Gatehouse read-only management API
info.description: Backend bearer-token integration. Disabled when MANAGEMENT_API_TOKEN is empty. Poll /api/v1/dashboard every 20 seconds by default. GET and HEAD only; no pagination or filters, query parameters are ignored. Paths are exact (no trailing slash). Browser sessions and CORS are not used. Collection errors are cached for the configured TTL and reported explicitly.

AdminActorHeader.name: X-Admin-Actor
AdminActorHeader.description: Optional sub-actor identifier (1..32 alphanumeric, dot, underscore, or hyphen characters) recorded in staff_events as api:<actor>.

managementBearer.description: Dedicated MANAGEMENT_API_TOKEN, minimum 32 printable ASCII characters without spaces. Send in Authorization only. No cookies or query-string credentials.

adminBearer.description: Dedicated ADMIN_API_TOKEN, minimum 32 printable ASCII characters without spaces, distinct from MANAGEMENT_API_TOKEN.

register_key.description: Empty string opens registration; otherwise 4..64 printable ASCII characters without spaces.

command.description: Worldserver console command (credential/account lifecycle commands are rejected).

Population.description: Online character counts. Humans include GMs; gms is a subset. Total is humans plus bots. Faction counts cover humans. Aggregate counts do not apply the Auctioneer roster exclusion.

realm_up.description: Successful read-only SOAP server info probe or TCP worldserver connection. False is valid realm-down data, not a collection error.

world_version.description: Empty when the optional world source/table/version row is absent.

raw.description: Numeric value in the units documented on the containing leaderboard.

arena.description: Raw units: arena points, not rating.

gold.description: Raw units: copper (10000 copper per gold).

Leaderboards.description: Each board uses LEADERBOARD_SIZE (default 20, maximum 100), excludes bot accounts and Auctioneer, and honors HIDE_GM. Offline characters are included.

Dashboard.description: Failed sections are null. Successful empty lists are []. Modules describe detected installations, not runtime health.

generated_at.description: Collection start timestamp in UTC, optionally with fractional seconds.

cache_ttl_seconds.description: Configured collection cache lifetime, default 20 seconds, measured after collection completes.
